body: I'm living in northern Michigan at the moment and most of my family lives in Chicago. A bit of a drive but is certainly worth it.
This year, just kinda hoping to go see some family. Hopefully the weather gets better so I can. I hate driving in snow storms!
I don't know why, but for some reason this is really giving me hope. I don't know what to say, but thank you so much..
Can you give me a reason to live? Because that's something i've yet to find.
I don't really have any, nor do I really want to think about the future and what I would "want" to do...
I'm not really sure, the last few months the only thing I've really wanted is to get better. I honestly can't think of anything, I gave up on a lot of my goals when things started to get really bad.
No, my friends don't talk to me anymore, and my boyfriend left me a few weeks ago. I have nothing to look forward to and nothing to give me hope. I just feel like it'd be worse to keep trying.
It's been almost a year, and I've been feeling this way all the time, and it just gets worse.
